ModMetaData.name: Rerun Faction Settlement Gen
ModMetaData.author: Greekin
ModMetaData.description:
Spawns the missing world bases for a faction in an existing save. Go to Mod Options -> Rerun Faction Settlement Gen, pick a faction, and press the button. The mod places however many bases the faction should have had at world generation, using the game's own settlement placement logic.
Works with planetside factions as well as orbital factions.
